faq.q: How much does palm pruning cost?
faq.a: It depends on height, access and condition. Small palms start around €60, tall ones can exceed €200. Send us a photo on WhatsApp for a free fixed quote.

faq.q: Do I need a permit to prune in Fuengirola?
faq.a: Routine maintenance in a private garden usually needs no permit. Felling or protected specimens may. We advise you for free before every job.
Yes. Every quote includes removal and disposal. Your garden stays clean.

faq.q: How often should a palm be pruned?
faq.a: Once a year is typical on the Costa del Sol, ideally spring or summer. We remind you when the next one is due.
